source._comment: LIVE 2026-10-21 (Sam: 'uf has some data for alaska'; the Lab's AK row cites the Division of Elections). Wired to the Division's own statistics page (elections.alaska.gov/statistics/, 'Absentee, Early, and Questioned Ballot Statistics'): the 2026 General block lists ballots issued/received by type with a 'Table last updated' stamp (10/20 2:16 pm: 11,876 received of 50,290 issued), fresher than the Lab (11,827). Statewide only, no party: the per-house-district/party 'Combined Report (htm)' (wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ComboReportRAll.html-new.html, and the 2024 one) returns a CloudFront 'Human Verification' page, HTTP 405, to scripts (measured 2026-10-21; the statistics page, the Division's PDFs and registration pages return 200) -- not bypassed. The site's certificate since 2026-10-07 omits its intermediate (GlobalSign GCC R46 OV TLS CA 2025); common.py loads it from assets/certs. Alaska registers voters by party, so if the district report becomes readable it can give the partisan split.
